scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:view && bun run typecheck:bun
scripts.build:api: mkdir -p build/api && bun build --target=bun --external usocket --external x11 --external playwright-core ./src/bun/server.ts --outfile build/api/server.js && bun build --target=bun --external usocket --external x11 --external playwright-core ./src/bun/cli.ts --outfile build/api/cli.js
scripts.build:electron: mkdir -p build/electron && bun build --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --external usocket --external x11 ./src/electron/main.ts --outfile build/electron/main.cjs && bun build --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --external usocket --external x11 ./src/electron/preload.ts --outfile build/electron/preload.cjs && install -m 0644 ./src/electron/package.json ./build/electron/package.json
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:api && bun run build:electron && bun run build:view
scripts.test: bun run test:bun && bun run test:renderer
